Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
8:58 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 go for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/i7 chip. Those matter far more than a fancy graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum. Pick 32 GB or an upgradeable slot if you run Docker, emulators or several projects at once.
Screen and keyboard: Full HD or better, a bright panel and a comfortable keyboard, since you'll stare at both all day.
Battery: Look for 8+ hours of real use, so a thin-and-light usually beats a gaming laptop.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you do games or AI training.
